keyword_plan_budget_forecast.summary: At $1,500 a month the mid case buys about 201 clicks and 24.1 leads at a $62 CPA, under break-even ($72). Forty leads a month needs about $2,815 a month in the mid case ($1,176 in the best case, $4,453 in the cautious one), and the mid-case CPA rises to $70, close to break-even, because the extra leads come from dearer keywords. Launch with the 11 keywords the budget fully funds; 6 wait for a bigger budget, "garage door repair" gets under 10% of its possible clicks, and 7 cost more per click than the business can pay at break-even.
